spots.name: Truuli Peak
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 2,015 m (6,611 ft).

spots.name: Kenai Fjords NP: Northwestern Fiord
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 118 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L1254311.

spots.name: Kvasnikoff Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt. About 213 m (699 ft) tall.

spots.name: Bradley Lake
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. The pin marks the middle of the lake: pick a shore spot facing the light.
